req.title: Player payload includes firstName and lastName
req.statement: The system shall include firstName and lastName fields on every player response.
triggers: player payload includes firstname and lastname

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that every player response must include 'firstName' and 'lastName'. The test suite will verify this by checking the presence of these fields in the response for valid, invalid, and boundary cases. This ensures that the API behaves correctly under normal, erroneous, and edge conditions.

tests.name: test_get_player_valid_id
preconditions: Player with ID '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802' exists in the database.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802')
assert response.status_code == 200
json_data = response.json()
assert 'firstName' in json_data
assert 'lastName' in json_data
assert json_data['firstName'] == 'Anjali'
assert json_data['lastName'] == 'Banerjee'

tests.name: test_get_player_invalid_id
preconditions: Player with ID '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' does not exist in the database.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
assert response.status_code == 404
